d:
Most people don’t need a complicated routine to feel better in their body. These 3 simple daily poses help reduce stiffness, improve mobility, and keep your body feeling more connected, stable, and pain free over time.
This short practice works through the front line, back line, hips, spine, and breath without overwhelming your nervous system. The real shift comes from consistency. A few minutes each day changes how you move, recover, sit, train, and respond to stress. Practice becomes less about fixing the body and more about staying connected to it.
